---

## 2. Founder Biography & Agency Philosophy

Karry is the founder of Surebound Insurance. His professional background in both personal and commercial insurance equips him to advise individuals, families, and commercial business owners with clarity and diligence. 

Karry's consultative model focuses on:
1. Conducting thorough risk assessments to uncover policy gaps (such as flood exclusions on standard homeowners policies, inadequate bodily injury limits, or unendorsed contractor liabilities).
2. Explaining coverage terms in plain English rather than insurance jargon.
3. Benchmarking rates across dozens of admitted and surplus lines carrier partners to fit policyholder budgets without sacrificing essential financial protection.

---

## 3. Product Catalog & Underwriting Specifications

### A. Personal Insurance Lines

#### 1. Homeowners Insurance (HO-3 & HO-5 Special Form)
- **Core Coverages:** Dwelling (Coverage A), Other Structures (Coverage B), Personal Property Replacement Cost (Coverage C), Loss of Use / Additional Living Expenses (Coverage D), Personal Liability (Coverage E - $300k-$1M), Medical Payments to Others (Coverage F).
- **Florida Specifics:** Hurricane windstorm endorsements, separate mandatory hurricane deductibles (typically 2%, 5%, or 10% of Coverage A), water backup endorsements, animal liability endorsements, and roof age / 4-point inspection qualification.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/home-insurance

#### 2. Florida Flood Insurance (NFIP & Private Flood)
- **Scope:** Flood is explicitly excluded from standard homeowners policies. Surebound provides FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) policies (up to $250k building / $100k contents) and Private Market Flood options (providing up to $1M+ dwelling limits, contents replacement cost, and temporary relocation benefits).
- **Coverage Triggers:** Inundation of two or more acres of normally dry land or two or more properties from overflow of tidal waters, unusual accumulation of surface runoff, or storm surge.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/property-insurance

#### 3. Personal Automobile Insurance
- **Florida Statutory Minimums:** Florida requires $10,000 Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and $10,000 Property Damage Liability (PDL). Surebound strongly advises clients to carry Bodily Injury Liability (BIL - $100k/$300k or $250k/$500k) and Uninsured/Underinsured Motorist (UM/UIM) coverage due to high regional uninsured driver statistics.
- **Endorsements:** Comprehensive, Collision, Rental Reimbursement, Emergency Roadside Assistance (dispatching via Progressive 1-800-776-4737).
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/auto-insurance

#### 4. Personal Umbrella Liability Insurance
- **Coverage Limits:** $1,000,000 to $10,000,000 in excess liability.
- **Purpose:** Protects personal equity, home value, brokerage portfolios, and future income from severe liability lawsuits arising from catastrophic vehicular accidents, property occurrences, or personal defamation.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/umbrella-insurance

#### 5. Individual Life & Family Health Insurance
- **Life Insurance:** 10, 20, 30-year Level Term Life, Whole Life, and Universal Life for income replacement, debt settlement, and wealth transfer.
- **Health Insurance:** Individual, family, and child ACA-compliant health plans, dental, and vision insurance.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/life-insurance | https://sureboundinsurance.com/health-insurance

---

### B. Commercial Insurance Lines

#### 1. Commercial General Liability (CGL)
- **Standard Limits:** $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 general aggregate.
- **Protection Areas:** Third-party bodily injury on business premises, third-party property damage caused by operations, products and completed operations liability, personal and advertising injury, defense legal fees outside policy limits.
- **Features:** Rapid Certificates of Insurance (COI) issuance, additional insured endorsements, waiver of subrogation, and primary/non-contributory language.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/liability-insurance

#### 2. Commercial Property Insurance & Business Interruption
- **Insured Assets:** Commercial buildings, tenant improvements & betterments (TIB), Business Personal Property (BPP - desks, computers, equipment, inventory).
- **Perils Covered:** Fire, windstorm, hurricane, vandalism, vehicle impact, sprinkler leakage. Includes business income coverage covering net profits and continuing payroll during covered disaster restorations.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/property-insurance

#### 3. Workers' Compensation Insurance
- **Regulatory Framework:** Florida Statute Title XXXI, Chapter 440. Construction businesses with 1 or more employees and non-construction businesses with 4 or more employees must carry valid Workers' Compensation.
- **Statutory Benefits:** 100% covered emergency medical care, temporary total disability (TTD) income replacement, impairment benefits, and death benefits.
- **Advisory Focus:** Accurate NCCI class code classification, Experience Modification Rate (EMR/MOD) auditing, payroll reconciliations, and safety program implementation discounts.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/workers-compensation

#### 4. Commercial Auto & Business Fleet Insurance
- **Vehicle Types:** Business sedans, pickup trucks, utility vans, box trucks, flatbeds, and tractor trailers.
- **Coverages:** Commercial auto liability ($500k to $1M+ CSL), collision, comprehensive, hired and non-owned auto (HNOA), cargo liability, and federal/state DOT compliance filings.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/commercial-auto-insurance

#### 5. Group Employee Benefits
- **Offerings:** Small group (2-50) and large group (50+) employer health insurance (HMO, PPO, HDHP/HSA), group dental, vision, life, short-term disability (STD), and long-term disability (LTD).
- **Features:** Section 125 cafeteria pre-tax setups, digital paperless enrollment portals, and annual market renewal benchmarking.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/group-benefits

#### 6. Surety Bonds & Contract Bonding
- **Categories:** Contract surety (bid bonds, performance bonds, payment bonds, maintenance bonds), commercial license & permit bonds, court bonds, and fiduciary bonds.
- **Carrier Backing:** Treasury-listed (T-Listed) surety underwriters capable of small fast-track bonding up to multi-million dollar bonding lines.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/surety-bond

#### 7. Business Owner's Policy (BOP)
- **Structure:** Cost-efficient single-policy package combining Commercial General Liability and Commercial Property for low-to-medium hazard businesses (offices, retail shops, contractors, service professionals) at bundled discounted rates.
- **Url:** https://sureboundinsurance.com/business-insurance

## 5. Billing, Grace Periods & Mortgage Escrow Instructions

- **Online Bill Pay:** Clients can pay premiums directly via credit card, debit, or ACH through carrier links published at https://sureboundinsurance.com/payment.
- **Florida Grace Periods:** Statutory and contractual grace periods typically provide 10 to 30 days past the due date before policy cancellation notices take effect.
- **Mortgagee Clause & Escrow Updates:** Title companies, mortgage loan officers, and escrow servicers can send verification requests, binder requests, and mortgagee clause updates to `billing@sureboundinsurance.com` or `support@sureboundinsurance.com` with same-day turnarounds.
